description: Minimal success and failure examples for the Micro Edit route. These are patterns, not a replacement for inspect and dry-run selector evidence.

successCases.intent: Replace one known text shape while preserving the deck structure.
minimumEvidence: inspect or select resolves exactly one shape on the intended slide
dry-run confirms the same slide and shape id/name
replacement is similar length or changed-slide preview is generated
qa: Keep inspect.json, patch.json, dry-run.json, and apply.json
Skip PNG only when text is same-length or shorter and dry-run reports no visual risk
escalateWhen: selector matches more than one shape
run-level formatting must be preserved but paragraph/run indexes are unknown

successCases.intent: Replace speaker notes on one slide.
minimumEvidence: slide index is confirmed from inspect or user instruction

ops.text: Emphasize the renewal risk and the mitigation owner.

qa: Notes-only edits usually do not need PNG rendering
Verify apply.json records only the requested slide notes change
escalateWhen: speaker notes need rich text structure that is not visible in inspect
notes must be synchronized across many slides

successCases.intent: Update a single footer, date, or page-number placeholder.
minimumEvidence: inspect exposes a footer/date/page-number placeholder or stable shape name
dry-run resolves exactly one footer-related target unless the user requested a batch edit
qa: Render a changed-slide PNG because footer/date/page-number edits sit in tight bboxes
Check dry-run for unexpected batch footer changes
escalateWhen: footer is inherited from layout/master and the target surface is unclear
user asks for a global footer policy change without a verified target set

successCases.intent: Set one or more deck core properties without changing slides.
minimumEvidence: core property names and values are explicit
qa: PNG rendering is not needed when no slide content changes
Verify apply.json records only core property updates
escalateWhen: metadata source of truth conflicts with visible slide text
custom document properties or package-level XML changes are requested

successCases.intent: Replace one picture while preserving its inspected position and size.
minimumEvidence: inspect identifies the intended picture by id/name and captures bbox
dry-run removes exactly the old picture and adds one replacement at the same bbox
qa: Always render the changed slide PNG
Compare bbox, aspect ratio, crop, and visible identity against the old picture
escalateWhen: crop or mask must be preserved but inspect does not expose enough context
asset identity, licensing, or provenance is unclear

successCases.intent: Change the fill or line color of one named object.
minimumEvidence: inspect resolves exactly one non-theme object
requested color is explicit as RGB or a known theme color
dry-run reports one object style change
qa: Render the changed slide PNG because visible style changed
Escalate if the request is really a theme or brand change
escalateWhen: same color must be applied across theme-driven objects
contrast, accessibility, or brand compliance must be revalidated deck-wide

successCases.intent: Remove one empty or default placeholder from one slide.
minimumEvidence: inspect confirms the placeholder type and slide
placeholder is empty/default and not the only visible content carrying user data
qa: Render the changed slide PNG when the placeholder is visible
Verify no layout/master placeholder was unintentionally edited
escalateWhen: placeholder contains non-default text or user content
removal should apply to a layout/master or multiple slides
template fidelity is part of the request

failureCases.intent: The user names text or an object that appears multiple times.
failureCases.failureSignal: select summary.matchCount is greater than 1 or dry-run resolves more than one target.
failureCases.microEditAction: Stop Micro Edit, gather stronger selector evidence, or route through edit-mode.md and inspect-and-edit.md.

failureCases.intent: The user asks to change all footers, dates, or page numbers without a verified slide/object set.
failureCases.failureSignal: dry-run cannot prove the expected batch count or includes inherited layout/master ambiguity.
failureCases.microEditAction: Use normal Edit and verify the target set before applying.

failureCases.intent: The change touches chart data, table structure, axes, labels, or embedded workbook semantics.
failureCases.failureSignal: requested change is semantic, not a localized text/style object patch.
failureCases.microEditAction: Escalate to edit-mode.md and the chart/table-specific workflow.

failureCases.intent: A picture should be replaced but crop, mask, aspect ratio, identity, or asset source is unclear.
failureCases.failureSignal: inspect does not expose enough geometry/crop context or asset provenance is missing.
failureCases.microEditAction: Use normal Edit with asset handling and changed-slide visual review.

failureCases.intent: The request implies layout, theme, brand, narrative, or visual system changes.
failureCases.failureSignal: the edit changes deck structure or design rules instead of one localized object.
failureCases.microEditAction: Route to Studio, DeckKit, template-following, or edit-mode as appropriate.

failureCases.intent: The user asks for partial text styling but paragraph/run boundaries are unknown.
failureCases.failureSignal: whole-frame text replacement would destroy formatting and inspect has not proven indexes.
failureCases.microEditAction: Inspect more deeply or escalate; do not guess run indexes.

failureCases.intent: A placeholder deletion might remove user content or affect inherited template behavior.
failureCases.failureSignal: placeholder contains non-default text/content or appears to be layout/master-owned.
failureCases.microEditAction: Use template-following or normal Edit and preview the changed slide before delivery.
